description: Search for specific tools by describing what you want to do. Returns the top matching tool definitions (name + description + input schema) ready to call immediately — no activation needed for one-off use. For repeated use of a group, call activate_category instead.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return (default 8, max 20).

query.description: Natural language description of what you want to do, e.g. "detect N+1 queries" or "list Symfony routes".

name: search_tools
